meta.title: CPZ — CardputerZero OS
meta.desc: CPZ is a terminal-first Linux for the CardputerZero handheld. It starts in a text terminal, keeps your tabs open, and manages Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, sound and power from one Settings menu.
hero.lead: A Linux for the CardputerZero handheld that starts in a text terminal instead of a desktop. Open tabs, split the screen, connect Wi-Fi and change settings — all from the keyboard.
why.title: Why CPZ
w1.t: Fast and light in a terminal
w1.d: CPZ starts straight into a terminal. It boots quickly, uses little memory and runs a large catalog of text apps that fit the small screen.
w2.d: Use the built-in panel or connect an HDMI monitor. Text and layout scale to either screen, and your session keeps running while you switch.
w3.t: Simple to set up and use
w3.d: Settings, search and the app catalog share one keyboard-driven interface. No config files, extra tools or desktop to learn.
install.title: Install
install.intro: One image, one microSD card, no setup wizard. The image is built for the CardputerZero hardware.
install.s2: Write it to a microSD card with Raspberry Pi Imager, balenaEtcher, dd or M5 Imager. Writing erases the card.
install.s3: Insert the card and power on. The first boot takes a little longer than later boots.
install.note: The release page lists the SHA-256; check it before writing.
install.after.title: First boot
install.after.login: Log in as cpz / cpz, then set a new password in Settings → System.
install.after.wifi: Turn on Wi-Fi in Settings → Connections. It is off by default.
install.after.power: Power off from Settings → Power. Do not pull the power.
install.after.usb: Plug in a USB drive; it opens in a new tab under /media.
keys.title: Keys
keys.intro: Hold Alt and press the key. This is the short list; Alt+H on the device shows every binding, including copy, paste and tab selection. Every shortcut can be reassigned in Settings → Keyboard → Shortcuts.
k.tabs.prev: Switch to the previous / next tab
k.panes.next: Switch to the next / previous pane
k.panes.zoom: Zoom the current pane (press again to restore)
k.session.display: Force the built-in screen / return to automatic
k.session.font: Make the text bigger / smaller (saved in Settings)
k.session.detach: Hide the session; log in again to return
settings.title: Settings
settings.intro: Change Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, sound, display and power with the arrow keys and Enter. Alt+S opens Settings at any time.
settings.network: Join Wi-Fi, pair Bluetooth devices, check Ethernet and manage VPNs and addresses
settings.display: Theme, brightness, screen timeout, text size, status bar and display output
settings.sound: Volume, mute, input and output device
settings.keyboard: Keyboard mapping, layouts, shortcut rebinding and the key list
settings.datetime: Date, time, time zone and automatic clock sync
settings.power: Battery status, restart, shut down and suspend
settings.apps: Browse, install and remove terminal apps
settings.system: About, system monitor, diagnostics, password, remote access (SSH) and reset
help.title: Help
help.intro: Most answers are one shortcut away on the device: Alt+H for keys, Alt+O for search and Alt+S for Settings.
footer.based: Based on Raspberry Pi OS and pi-gen. Built for the CardputerZero handheld.
